The Allied squadrons which sailed in the early part of the year , in order to make a second attack upon Petropaulovski , have been disappointed in their expected revenge . In the early part of last May , the fleet appeared before the town ; butto their great surprise , they found an American , instead of a Russian , flag flying from the walls , and a strange silence and appearance of desertion about the place . On landing , the officers found that the town had been evacuatedand that the only human beings left were two or three Americans and a runaway French sailor .
